issue_title: 🎯 Restore/Buffer Request Body after Middleware Consumption to Prevent EOF in BodyParser
issue_body_sample:
## 📝 Description
When a middleware (such as logging, audit, size-limit, or signature verification) reads the request body stream, the underlying stream is drained.
